simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to סָעִף (H5587) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: סָעִף (çâʻiph) means divided (in mind), i.e. (abstractly) a sentiment First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 18 21.

definitions.full: H5587. saiph [ סְעִמָּה ] noun feminine division, divided opinion ; — plural absolute הַסְּעִמִּים עַלשְֿׁתֵּי 1Kin 18:21 how long are ye limping on the two divided opinions (as on unequal legs; ᵐ5 ταῖς ἰγνύαις seems an attempt to interpret the figurative; according to Albr ZAW xvi (1896) 75 {abbrev } ס really = legs ). שְׂעִמִּים noun [masculine] plural disquietings , = disquieting or excited thoughts; — ׳שׂ Job 4:13 ; suffix שְׂעִמַּי (Baer שְׂעִימַּי ) 20:2 (|| חוּשִׁי ).
